name: Reactions Total
author: Daxo-Developer @Daxo_OS
summary: Reaction totals in the message timestamp line, with compact counts, paid-reaction and channel filters.
limitations: Requires native engine API 8. Uses the native timestamp line instead of modifying author metadata. Saved Messages tags and non-cloud messages are excluded.
Changes appear on the next cell update or after reopening the chat. Android debug bulletins are not used.
